description: This file defines a DownloadController class for managing download items, their statuses, and interactions with a database and download engine in a Flutter app. It includes data models, enums, and methods for enqueueing, removing, pausing/resuming downloads, and restoring state from disk.

classes.name: DownloadItem
classes.description: Data model representing individual download items with serialization and deserialization methods.

classes.name: DownloadController
classes.description: Controller managing download operations, state, and persistence, utilizing a download engine and database.

methods.name: restoreFromDisk
methods.description: Restores download items from local database and resumes downloading if not paused.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a new download item with specified content ID and title, and initiates download if not paused.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a download by content ID, cancels ongoing download, and updates the database.

methods.name: togglePaused
methods.description: Toggles the paused state of all downloads, pausing or resuming as appropriate.

methods.name: _upsertProgress
methods.description: Updates or inserts download progress status into the database.

methods.name: _startSimulation
methods.description: Starts a simulated download process for a specific content ID, updating progress via callback.
